purpose: Close IR-20 on the REG.RU Docker Compose production contour: publish and verify exact-SHA API, web, migration and canonical outbox-worker images; apply the forward-only canonical outbox migration; activate exactly one dedicated outbox worker with the least-privilege app_outbox principal and one internal persistent Kafka broker pinned by digest; prove a live durable outbox delivery; observe the exact runtime for 30 minutes; and preserve fail-closed rollback.
forbiddenCapabilities: using latest or other mutable tags for API web migration outbox-worker or Kafka
running migrations from API or outbox-worker runtime credentials
database down-migration or destructive schema rollback
enabling an outbox delivery runner inside API or creating a second production outbox owner
publishing Kafka ports on the production host or accepting a broker outside the protected Compose project
granting app_outbox superuser bypassrls create database create role replication inheritance insert delete or tenant-domain privileges
printing SSH keys passwords database URLs protected paths or resolved Compose secrets
bypassing host fingerprint verification or exact OCI revision binding
declaring IR-20 production acceptance without exact worker revision live outbox delivery broker persistence and the bounded observation
changing application product code packages lockfiles Caddy PostgreSQL Redis MinIO or unrelated runtime services
acceptance: the release candidate is the exact SHA captured by the owner controller and remains an ancestor of current main at every mutation boundary
API web migration and outbox-worker images are immutable registry-digest references with OCI revision equal to the target SHA
the canonical durable-outbox migration completes before worker activation and the reclaim fence plus RLS catalog checks pass
exactly one production outbox-worker runs with OUTBOX_WORKER_ENABLED=true KAFKA_REQUIRED=true RUNTIME_COMPONENT=outbox-worker while API is forced to OUTBOX_WORKER_ENABLED=false
app_outbox is a login runtime principal with row_security on only the required outbox SELECT and update-column privileges and no tenant-domain authority
the internal Kafka broker is pinned by digest has no published host ports uses a persistent named volume and retains the required topics across a controlled restart
the live organization-intake outbox row reaches SENT or CONFIRMED through the canonical worker after Kafka acknowledgement
API web and outbox-worker runtime image bindings equal the target SHA and unrelated production containers remain invariant
the exact worker and broker stay healthy with stable ownership during the 30-minute observation
post-deploy failure performs the bounded target rollback while the forward-compatible schema is retained and protected evidence is checksummed on issue 4637
